people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
translations.bsb: These were the names of the men Moses sent to spy out the land; and Moses gave to Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.
translations.kjv: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
translations.asv: These are the names of the men that Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
